[ENHANCEMENT] Add a formatDuration() helper for converting a ledger-count duration into a human-readable estimate
[BUG] assertValidPublicKey() utility accepts a valid-looking StrKey that actually decodes to a muxed account or contract address, when only a plain account address is expected
[BUG] debounce() utility's cancel() method doesn't prevent an already-scheduled trailing call that was mid-flight when cancel() was invoked
[BUG] formatAmount() utility doesn't respect the caller's locale for decimal/thousands separators
[BUG] retry() utility's exponential backoff calculation can produce a delay of 0ms on the first retry due to an off-by-one in the exponent
[BUG] Test coverage reporting (via .size-limit.json-adjacent tooling) excludes the node subpath entirely, hiding its actual coverage level
[BUG] CI's e2e test suite is flaky because it polls testnet ledger close with a fixed short timeout that's sometimes too short under real network conditions
[BUG] Shared test fixtures for escrow scenarios hardcode a specific testnet contract ID that's no longer deployed, breaking tests that don't mock the RPC
[BUG] Per-wallet token bucket doesn't key by network, letting testnet traffic exhaust a wallet's mainnet quota
[BUG] Storage adapter interface doesn't expose a way to detect storage availability before use, so SSR environments throw at import time
[BUG] LocalStorageAdapter doesn't handle QuotaExceededError, silently failing to persist session data instead of surfacing a usable error
[BUG] Sentry sample rate is hardcoded to 100% in all environments, including production, risking quota exhaustion and added latency
[BUG] Notification preferences (opt-out) are checked after rendering the notification content, wasting work for opted-out users
[BUG] Notification dispatch silently drops notifications when the target channel is unavailable, with no dead-letter record
[BUG] useDisputeStatus() polling hook doesn't pause when the browser tab is backgrounded, wasting requests
[BUG] useWallet() hook doesn't clean up its subscription on unmount, causing a 'setState on unmounted component' warning
[BUG] useEscrow() hook re-fetches on every render because its internal useEffect dependency array includes a non-memoized options object
[BUG] Gig search filters silently ignore an invalid 'category' value instead of returning a validation error
[BUG] Node CLI helper for batch-submitting transactions from a CSV doesn't validate row data before starting submission, failing midway through a large batch
[BUG] Deliverable list endpoint doesn't paginate, returning every deliverable for a long-running gig in one response
[BUG] Node-only entrypoint (@trustflow/sdk/node) throws when imported from an Edge runtime instead of giving a clear 'not supported' error
[BUG] Deliverable submission accepts an empty/placeholder file hash
[ENHANCEMENT] Add a getAccountSummary() helper that combines balance, sequence, and subentry count in one call
[BUG] .env loading order silently lets backend/.env override values already set by the root .env
[BUG] mergeAccount() helper doesn't warn when merging an account that still has open trustlines, which Stellar will reject
[BUG] fundTestnetAccount() (friendbot helper) doesn't handle the case where the account already exists and is already funded
[BUG] createKeypair() doesn't zero out the secret key material from memory after it's been used to derive the public key for display-only purposes
[ENHANCEMENT] Add an onProgress callback to submit() for stage-level progress reporting
[BUG] JWT secret is logged in plaintext when startup config validation fails
[BUG] Page size parameter has no upper bound, allowing a caller to request an unbounded result set
[BUG] Pipeline silently drops a caller-provided custom timeout in favor of its own hardcoded default for the confirmation-polling stage
[BUG] Idempotency store entries never expire, causing unbounded Redis memory growth
[BUG] Redis key TTLs for nonces and idempotency keys aren't set atomically with the key write, leaving a brief window with no expiry
[ENHANCEMENT] Add a waitForLedgerClose() helper for tests/scripts that need to advance past a specific ledger
[BUG] Horizon client's account-exists check treats a 404 the same as a network error, both producing identical error messages
[BUG] Admin audit log doesn't record which admin wallet performed a given migration run or rollback
[BUG] stroopsToXlm() doesn't handle a BigInt input consistently with a string input, producing different output formats
[BUG] Verification badge type doesn't narrow correctly in TypeScript, allowing an invalid badge string to type-check
[BUG] Horizon client doesn't retry on a transient 504 from a load-balanced Horizon endpoint
[BUG] searchProfiles() doesn't URL-encode the search query, breaking searches containing special characters
[BUG] getProfile() returns a cached stale profile for a short window after updateProfile() resolves
[BUG] Profile search is case-sensitive and doesn't match partial wallet aliases
[BUG] Reveal-phase helper doesn't validate the revealed plaintext matches the originally committed ciphertext's hash
[BUG] Indexer doesn't emit a metric for consumer-group lag, making backlog invisible until queries start timing out
